exposure: Exposure to the Lausanne Infant Crying Stress Paradigm (LICSP)
Low vs. high risk of CB-PTSD
Risk of childbirth-related posttraumatic stress disorder (CB-PTSD)
cohort: 52 early postpartum mothers, 28 at low risk and 24 at high risk for childbirth-related posttraumatic stress disorder.
finding: The LICSP effectively induced subjective stress and autonomic nervous system reactivity in the mothers, with high-risk mothers showing higher perceived stress and altered stress reactivity compared to low-risk mothers.
